title: A Day in My Life - Slow English Podcast (A1 – Present Simple)

header.titleZh: 我生命中的一天 - 慢速英語podcast（A1 – 現在簡單）
header.titleEn: A Day in My Life - Slow English Podcast (A1 – Present Simple)

sentences.en: And I hop on video calls. I drive to the supermarket.
sentences.tc: 我開始視訊通話。我開車去超市。

sentences.en: I get vegetables and fruits. I order some food.
sentences.tc: 我得到蔬菜和水果。我點了一些食物。

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: Today I'm going to tell you about my daily routine. I'll speak slowly and clearly so that you can understand and practice listening.
sentences.tc: 今天我就跟大家講講我的日常。我會慢慢地、清楚地講，以便你能理解並練習聽力。

sentences.en: I wake up around 5 a.m. To have an early start to the morning.
sentences.tc: 我早上 5 點左右起床，以便早點開始新的一天。

sentences.en: I like to start my day slowly.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡慢慢開始新的一天。

sentences.en: I read a book. This morning.
sentences.tc: 我讀了一本書。今晨。

sentences.en: I saw a little gua, a small lizard hanging on my sheets.
sentences.tc: 我看到我的床單上掛著一隻小卦，一隻小蜥蜴。

sentences.en: I love the sounds.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡這些聲音。

sentences.en: I go downstairs.
sentences.tc: 我下樓。

sentences.en: I brush my teeth and I sit down to start work. I check emails. I edit videos. I plan my lessons. And I hop on video calls. And meetings.
sentences.tc: 我刷完牙，坐下來開始工作。我檢查電子郵件。我編輯影片。我規劃我的課程。我開始視訊通話。還有會議。

sentences.en: Then I make breakfast something filling so I can feel full for a long time. Most mornings.
sentences.tc: 然後我會做早餐，這樣我就能長時間感到飽足。大多數早晨。

sentences.en: I like to eat chickpeas, onions, and potatoes. It's delicious. After I finish eating breakfast, I put on my shoes. I grab my helmet and I drive to the supermarket.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡吃鷹嘴豆、洋蔥和馬鈴薯。很好吃。吃完早餐後，我就穿上鞋子。我抓起頭盔，開車去超市。

sentences.en: I go through each aisle to make sure.
sentences.tc: 我會穿過每條過道來確認。

sentences.en: I don't forget anything. Of course, the bakery is.
sentences.tc: 我什麼都沒有忘記。當然是麵包店了。

sentences.en: My favorite part because I always crave a sweet treat at the end of the day.
sentences.tc: 我最喜歡的部分是因為我總是渴望在一天結束時吃點甜食。

sentences.en: I like to be well prepared for when I crave something sweet. That way.
sentences.tc: 當我渴望吃甜食時，我喜歡做好充分準備。那樣。

sentences.en: I don't have to go back to the supermarket again.
sentences.tc: 我不用再去超市了。

sentences.en: I get vegetables and fruits and I stroll through the detergent aisle.
sentences.tc: 我買了蔬菜和水果，然後在洗滌劑通道上漫步。

sentences.en: I love the smell of the detergent aisle.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡洗滌劑通道的氣味。

sentences.en: We drive home and I make lunch.
sentences.tc: 我們開車回家，我做午餐。

sentences.en: I love to eat broccoli pasta with cheese and ham.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡吃西蘭花義大利麵配起司和火腿。
